name: devto-mcp
description: Dev.to (social): me, read_comments, analytics_post. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_devto_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_DEVTO_API_KEY
platform_mcp_devto_api_key.description: DEV Community API key (dev.to > Settings > Extensions > DEV Community API Keys); sent as the `api-key` header.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /api/users/me returns the authenticated user (MyUser: id, username, name, ...).

tools.name: read_comments
tools.description: Threaded: each top-level comment carries its replies nested inline (in `raw`); `page` filters top-level comments only. The v1 schema documents only type_of, id_code, created_at, image_url, so author/text are not mapped.

tools.name: analytics_post
tools.description: Public reaction counts from the article record (ArticleIndex); the runtime cannot compose a nested `metrics` object, so counts are top-level fields.
